verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ بِالْمُصْطَفَى بَلِّغْ مَقَاصِدَنَا ۞ وَاغْفِرْ لَنَا مَا مَضَى يَا وَاسِعَ الْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi bi-l-Muṣṭafā balligh maqāṣidanā · wa-ghfir lanā mā maḍā yā wāsiʿa-l-karami
verses.en: O my Lord, by the Chosen One bring us to our goals, and forgive us what has passed, O Vast in generosity.

verses.ar: يَا أَكْرَمَ الْخَلْقِ مَا لِي مَنْ أَلُوذُ بِهِ ۞ سِوَاكَ عِنْدَ حُلُولِ الْحَادِثِ الْعَمَمِ
verses.tr: Yā akrama-l-khalqi mā lī man alūdhu bihi · siwāka ʿinda ḥulūli-l-ḥādithi-l-ʿamami
verses.en: O most generous of creation, I have no one to shelter with but you when the all-encompassing calamity descends.

verses.ar: وَلَنْ يَضِيقَ رَسُولَ اللّٰهِ جَاهُكَ بِي ۞ إِذَا الْكَرِيمُ تَجَلَّى بِاسْمِ مُنْتَقِمِ
verses.tr: Wa lan yaḍīqa Rasūlallāhi jāhuka bī · idhā-l-Karīmu tajallā bi-smi muntaqimi
verses.en: Your standing, O Messenger of Allah, will not fall short of me when the Generous One manifests with the name of the Avenger.

verses.ar: فَإِنَّ مِنْ جُودِكَ الدُّنْيَا وَضَرَّتَهَا ۞ وَمِنْ عُلُومِكَ عِلْمَ اللَّوْحِ وَالْقَلَمِ
verses.tr: Fa-inna min jūdika-d-dunyā wa ḍarratahā · wa min ʿulūmika ʿilma-l-lawḥi wa-l-qalami
verses.en: For of your bounty is this world and the next, and of your knowledge is knowledge of the Tablet and the Pen.

verses.ar: يَا نَفْسُ لَا تَقْنَطِي مِنْ زَلَّةٍ عَظُمَتْ ۞ إِنَّ الْكَبَائِرَ فِي الْغُفْرَانِ كَاللَّمَمِ
verses.tr: Yā nafsu lā taqnaṭī min zallatin ʿaẓumat · inna-l-kabā'ira fī-l-ghufrāni ka-l-lamami
verses.en: O soul, do not despair over an enormous slip — before forgiveness, the gravest sins are as small ones.

verses.ar: لَعَلَّ رَحْمَةَ رَبِّي حِينَ يَقْسِمُهَا ۞ تَأْتِي عَلٰى حَسَبِ الْعِصْيَانِ فِي الْقِسَمِ
verses.tr: Laʿalla raḥmata Rabbī ḥīna yaqsimuhā · ta'tī ʿalā ḥasabi-l-ʿiṣyāni fī-l-qisami
verses.en: Perhaps my Lord's mercy, when He apportions it, will arrive in measure with the extent of one's sins.

verses.ar: يَا رَبِّ وَاجْعَلْ رَجَائِي غَيْرَ مُنْعَكِسٍ ۞ لَدَيْكَ وَاجْعَلْ حِسَابِي غَيْرَ مُنْخَرِمِ
verses.tr: Yā Rabbi wa-jʿal rajā'ī ghayra munʿakisin · ladayka wa-jʿal ḥisābī ghayra munkharimi
verses.en: O my Lord, let not my hope in You be overturned, and let not my account be found wanting.

verses.ar: وَالْطُفْ بِعَبْدِكَ فِي الدَّارَيْنِ إِنَّ لَهُ ۞ صَبْرًا مَتَى تَدْعُهُ الْأَهْوَالُ يَنْهَزِمِ
verses.tr: Wa-lṭuf bi-ʿabdika fī-d-dārayni inna lahu · ṣabran matā tadʿuhu-l-ahwālu yanhazimi
verses.en: Be gentle with Your servant in both abodes, for his patience flees whenever terrors summon it.

verses.ar: وَائْذَنْ لِسُحْبِ صَلَاةٍ مِنْكَ دَائِمَةٍ ۞ عَلٰى النَّبِيِّ بِمُنْهَلٍّ وَمُنْسَجِمِ
verses.tr: Wa'dhan li-suḥbi ṣalātin minka dā'imatin · ʿalā-n-Nabiyyi bi-munhallin wa munsajimi
verses.en: And bid clouds of Your blessings to pour perpetually upon the Prophet, in downpour and in steady stream,

verses.ar: وَالْآلِ وَالصَّحْبِ ثُمَّ التَّابِعِينَ فَهُمْ ۞ أَهْلُ التُّقَى وَالنَّقَى وَالْحِلْمِ وَالْكَرَمِ
verses.tr: Wa-l-āli wa-ṣ-ṣaḥbi thumma-t-tābiʿīna fa-hum · ahlu-t-tuqā wa-n-naqā wa-l-ḥilmi wa-l-karami
verses.en: and upon the family, the companions, then the followers — for they are the people of piety, purity, forbearance and generosity.
